purpose: Managed work, transition guards, durability, notifications and completion.
use: Work needing durable continuity or managed governance (typically G2+): open or attach a ticket or equivalent item before effects; report each transition.
semantic_conditions: G0 may stay ephemeral and G1 may use existing issue, PR or version control evidence; G2-G4 need managed facts.
mandatory_preconditions: Classified governance level, effective scope and expected prior ticket state/revision.
postconditions_verification: Each creation and transition durably published, read back and reported to the user; completion gate satisfied.
